doubledelta.alias_policy: one source grid per physical family

blendednet.condition_bands: Mach quantiles 0.70 and 0.85, frozen from metadata before field export or training
blendednet.train: geometry hash fold <80 and Mach <= q70
blendednet.val: geometry hash fold 80..89 and q70 < Mach <= q85
blendednet.test: geometry hash fold >=90 and Mach > q85

field_training.primary: pretrained vs same architecture scratch; matched examples/order/updates/LR
field_training.reference_condition_input: normalised condition vector through a zero-output-initialised MLP added to geometry token states; no sensor readings
field_training.selection: mean validation nRMSE on all four fixed sensor counts, max 64 fixed dev cases
field_training.sensor_locations: fixed independent of pressure labels and identical across methods
field_training.fields: Native preprocessed nondimensional pressure coefficient; no repeat unit conversions
field_training.query_rule: fixed uniform without replacement subset of native surface vertices with original lumped area weights
field_training.uncertainty: paired bootstrap over physical geometry families, mean over seeds
field_training.test_policy: fixed configuration, best validation checkpoint only; no test-driven retries

resource_policy: CPU preparation independently; one GPU per field fit; four GPUs per pretraining fit; Slurm resources and afterok dependencies
gates: finite aligned arrays with outward normals and positive mass
hidden-target mutation cannot change inputs or predictions
native checkpoint weights preserved when adding field channels
finite loss and gradients in GPU preflight
